title: ActionProposal
description: Later-phase contract, absent from Phase 1 on purpose ('currently no actions will be taken'). It pins the strategic decision: Olly Sentinel becomes a component with TROUBLESHOOT / REMEDIATE actions, invokable via Self-Healing or an authorized user request. The model proposes one action from a closed enum; a human approves; a deterministic executor performs it under a write-entitled identity that is not gco-sentinel-read. The model never holds execution credentials.

correlation_id.description: The join key from the originating event; the executor resolves the target through it, never through free text.

action.description: Closed enum, deliberately tiny: the TROUBLESHOOT component action (read-only deep dive), one concrete remediation shape (service restart via the Execution Layer), and the null action. Growing this list is a governance decision, not a code change.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers into the RCA enrichment evidence entries this proposal rests on.

state.description: Only a deterministic executor moves proposed -> executed, and only via approved.
